title: tabernaemontana decaisnei
intro: Tabernaemontana decaisnei, commonly known as the Himalayan snail vine or Himalayan tabernaemontana, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tabernaemontana decaisnei include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which are attributed to the plant's ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and relax muscles. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, such as voacamine and voacristine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
